summary: Current demo build. !transcribe works as a reply to any voice note, including in chats without auto-transcribe, and the bot pauses 1 s between Signal receive polls so sends and typing calls get the account sooner.

The first build with GitHub-signed image provenance. Checks for group invites when a group update arrives instead of listing groups every 5 s, and logs every verified NEAR AI response; replaced by 1c58c2e7.

Verifies NEAR AI: each translation must be signed by an attested model GPU TEE (Intel TDX quote, NVIDIA GPUs), and Whisper is re-attested every half hour. !verify reports the agent registration and these model checks; replaced by 92154d57.
The agent pays for its own transfer when it returns refunded registration deposits, so each boot's account keeps only about 0.003 NEAR; replaced by 5f0f9eb9.
Native signal-cli for faster replies, failed relayed calls reported with the contract's error, typing calls off the reply path, and a low-sponsor warning; replaced by 812dae7d.

The sponsor relays registration as a meta-transaction, so each boot's account holds only 0.003 NEAR. Styled replies, a copyable !verify quote, and a typing indicator while commands run; replaced by 0634364c.
Funds each agent account enough for prepaid gas, and registers only after the Signal check passes; replaced by 05be66bc.
First demo build. Registered, but funded agents too little for prepaid gas; replaced by a949c1ff.
